result.question: What does Yahweh's word say to the man?

readings.answer: That his body will never reach the tomb of his fathers
readings.support: your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers.

readings.answer: That he went back and ate bread and drank water where he was told not to
readings.support: but you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so

assessments.reason: The verse says “your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers,” which closely matches the key’s idea though it specifies not reaching the family tomb rather than flatly “won’t be buried.”

Verse 22 explicitly says he went back and ate bread and drank water where he was told not to, which is also part of what Yahweh’s word says to him, though the key selects the burial consequence instead.

result.reason: Verse 13:22 states both the man’s disobedience and the consequence about his body not reaching his fathers’ tomb, so the question allows more than one distinct correct answer.
